_comment: Frosted glass: clear soda-lime glass whose surface is acid-etched or sandblasted, so light passes but blurs (shower screens, office partitions, lamp shades). TranslucentThin: a pane is a thin shell seen through, the same master as Glass_Clear and Glass_Green. The frost is the surface roughness, nothing else: the same glass as Glass_Clear with a rough face. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints, gated by the Grime mask. Water spots would be a fourth; per C3 that is a sibling article. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Glass_Frosted_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: roughness_const is not taken (the entry is polished glass); the frost is the judgement below.

sources.why: roughness 0.45 for an acid-etched or sandblasted face (light passes but blurs); transmission_color 0.94, 0.97, 0.95, the faint green of ordinary clear soda-lime pane glass.
